    requires |lst| == 2
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |lst| ==> forall c :: c in lst[i] ==> c == '(' || c == ')'
    ensures result == "Yes" || result == "No"

    ensures (result == "No" ==> forall i :: 0 <= i < 2 && forall j :: 0 <= j < 2 && i != j ==> !canFormGoodString(lst[i], lst[j]))

// Helper function to determine if two strings can form a good string when concatenated
method canFormGoodString(s1: string, s2: string) returns (isGood: bool)
    ensures isGood == (balance(s1 + s2) == 0)
    
// Helper function to compute the balance of parentheses
method balance(s: string) returns (b: int)
    decreases |s|
    ensures b >= 0
    ensures b == countOpen(s) - countClose(s)

method countOpen(s: string) returns (count: int)
    decreases |s|
    ensures count >= 0

method countClose(s: string) returns (count: int)
    decreases |s|
    ensures count >= 0
```
